questions.explanation:
Given

(i)   2Fe2O3(s) 4Fe(s) + 3O2(g);

rGo = + 1487.0 kJ mol-1

(ii)   2CO(g) + O2(g) 2CO2(g);

rGo = 514.4 kJ mol-1

Multiply reaction (ii) with 3 and we get,

(iii)   6CO(g) + 3O2 (g)       6CO2(g) ;

rGo = 3 514.4 = 1543.2 kJ mol1

Now add reaction (i)   with  (iii), we get

2Fe2O3(s) + 6CO(g)       4Fe(s) + 6CO2(g)

Free energy change of the reaction,

rGo  =  1487.0 1543.2  =  56.2 kJ/mol
